target_selection_basis: not among CHEMBL220, CHEMBL203, CHEMBL230, CHEMBL284, or CHEMBL335
biological relevance to natural-product or drug-discovery screening
at least 3000 ChEMBL exact-IC50 records with non-null pChEMBL before normalization
outcome: absolute difference between prior-publication and latest-year median exact-IC50 pActivity of at least 1.0 log10 unit
strict_exclusions: target overlap with any previous five-target experiment
compound seen anywhere in the previous five normalized target snapshots
activity, assay, or publication identifier seen anywhere in the previous five normalized target snapshots
overlap with any prior 531-event development/evaluation row
same assay or publication on both sides of an event
non-exact, censored, invalid, duplicate, inconsistent, or incompatible measurements
support_rule: Frozen full-model study-clustered AUROC lower 95% bound > 0.5, PR-AUC lower 95% bound > observed prevalence, and Brier score no worse than the frozen constant-prevalence fallback.
